patterns.note: Geometric color blocking and split-screen layouts are used as primary design elements, creating distinct visual sections.
A dense, irregular grid layout is used for image galleries, packing many visuals tightly without much whitespace.
High-contrast, saturated color blocks (orange, pink, dark teal) are used as foundational background elements, defining page sections.
No scroll-triggered motion is observed within the provided scroll sequence; page transitions appear to be direct loads between distinct, static visual states.
Minimalist sans-serif typography is consistently applied across all text, relying on size and weight for hierarchy rather than varied fonts.

technique_notes: The site employs a highly graphic approach by using full-screen or split-screen solid color blocks as the main structural and aesthetic components of a page.
Image content is presented in a tight, masonry-like grid where images of varying aspect ratios are packed closely together, maximizing visual impact and density.
Motion is handled through direct page transitions or route changes, rather than scroll-triggered animations; each 'screen' or page appears as a complete, static composition upon load.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clean sans-serif with a balanced hierarchy; headings are moderately larger than body text, relying on weight for emphasis.
design_tokens.spacing: Dense in image grids, balanced in text sections, with large color blocks creating an airy feel overall.

standout: The site's distinctive use of bold, flat color blocks as primary layout elements, combined with a stark, geometric aesthetic, creates a highly graphic and editorial feel that stands apart from typical marketing sites. The tight, irregular photo grids also contribute to a unique visual density.
